architecture-reference.prompt: Create a clean architecture plate from this existing background. Remove counter, stools/chairs, loose foreground decor and back-bar furniture; reconstruct hidden wall and floor. Preserve fixed architecture and source perspective.

shelf-reference.prompt: Isolate the existing back-bar furniture from this source region. Remove all painted bottles and glassware. Preserve exact perspective.

counter-reference.prompt: Isolate the existing bar counter with transparent surroundings and 24 px bleed. Preserve its exact perspective and silhouette.

review.reason: Window geometry and occluded surfaces cannot be inferred reliably from gameplay anchors alone.

notes: Generated from the measured gameplay geometry already used by BarScene.
Do not ship reference crops as final modules until the clean architecture plate and transparency have been visually reviewed.
Keep camera, horizon and perspective identical to the source.
Remove painted bottles from shelf modules; decorative bottles are rendered by shelf presets.
If counter/seating hides wall or floor, reconstruct the hidden surface by inpainting before export.
